# Files app icon

The app icon in `src/app/pulse.ico`, `src/app/pulse-icon.png`, and
`assets/global-search-logo.png` comes from the Files project by Files Community.

- Source: https://github.com/files-community/Files
- Source revision: `0e3c17ca44d143fb656be27eacf2b25c22a62043`
- Files: `src/Files.App/Assets/AppTiles/Release/Logo.ico` and
  `src/Files.App/Assets/AppTiles/Release/Square44x44Logo.targetsize-256.png`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE-MIT.txt` in this directory.

Pulse is a separate project and is not affiliated with Files Community.
